turn: The geofence exit check now works by cell lookup. In `src/geofence/h3-check.ts`, `insideZone` converts the lat/lon to an H3 cell at `ZONE_RES` and checks whether that cell is in the zone's cell set, so there is no polygon math at check time. I haven't run the test suite or any other check on it, so it's untested. While I was in the geofence module I also fixed a small unplanned problem in the same commit. A debug log line was printing full device coordinates, and it now logs only the cell ID. Next I'll start on "Cache for geofence polygons".

sidefix.title: Stop logging raw device coordinates
sidefix.what: Replaced a debug log line that printed full device lat/lon with one that logs only the H3 cell ID.
